lead.hed: Why India tops the list of abandoned sailors
lead.deck: India supplies more merchant crew than almost any country on earth — and more abandoned seafarers than any. Of the 3,133 sailors left stranded worldwide in 2024, about 900 were Indians.

briefs.text: A journalist working on the edit page of Hindustan Times has joined the BBC, where he, sources say, will report and produce stories on India and the region.
Called An Ordinary Man's Guide to Growing Up Muslim in India, the book examines identity, secularism and migration in contemporary India. It was written as part of a New India Foundation fellowship.
A journalist claims he has contributed to The New York Times, The Caravan and Al Jazeera English on a range of subjects, among them
